article_content: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si lama filaan ah ugu baaqday Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay in deg deg looga hortago saldhig ciidan oo Imaaraatka Carabtu ka dhigeyso Somaliland, iyadoo ay jiraan shaki weyn iyo tuhun laga qabo qorshahan la yaabka leh. Markii uu la hadlayay Golaha Ammaanka, safiirka Soomaaliya ee Qaramada Midoobay, Abukar Osman, ayaa si caro leh u sheegay in heshiiska Somaliland iyo Imaaraatka ee Berbera uu yahay khiyaano cad oo heer caalami ah. Osman waxa uu Golaha ka codsaday inay si taxaddar leh uga jawaabaan arrimahaas, inkastoo dadka degaanka qaarkood ay sheegeen in Qaramada Midoobay lafteedu xiriir la leedahay Imaaraadka ee mashruucan muranka dhaliyay. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya si adag ayay u cambaareyneysaa falalkan, waxayna ballanqaadaysaa inay tallaabooyin kama dambeys noqon doona ka qaadi doonto si loo ilaaliyo midnimada, xasiloonida, iyo jiritaanka Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri. Warar kale waxay sheegayaan in Imaaraadku uu tababari doono ciidamo gaar ah oo Somaliland ah, lana filayo in lagu sameeyo tijaabooyin cusub oo hub iyo farsamooyin hor leh loo adeegsan doono. Berbera waa dekad muhiim ah oo la sheegay in lagu rakibay qalab casri ah oo sirdoon ah, halka Imaaraadkuna sheegay inuu halkaas ka fulin doono qorshayaal milatari oo qarsoodi ah, kuwaasoo la xidhiidha dagaalada Yemen. Shirkadda DP World, oo ay la daalaa-dhacayso eedaymo musuqmaasuq, ayaa sheegtay 2016 inay $442m galin doonto Berbera, halka Itoobiya si lama filaan ah uga baxday heshiiskii ay kula jirtay dekadda. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa si toos ah u mamnuucay DP World, laakiin Somaliland waxay tiri amarkaasi waxba ka beddeli doonin heshiiskii hore, xilli dad badan ay baqdin weyn ka qabaan in iska horimaad dhaco. DP World waxay dhawaan la kulantay khasaare kale, kadib markii Djibouti kusoo rogtay ganaax lacageed oo la yaab leh, iyadoo la sheegay in heshiiskooda uu khal khal geliyay amniga gobolka oo dhan.

article_content: Sanad dugsiyeedka cusub, wasaaradda waxbarashadu waxay go'aamisay in uu jiro hal xilli oo kaliya oo lagu qiimeeyo ardayda dhammaan dugsiyada hoose, dhexe iyo kuwa muusikada, sida uu sheegay wasiirka Simona Kustec. Taasi waxay la macno tahay in ardaydu fasalka ama sanadka dhammeyn doonaan iyadoo la siinayo tiro aad u yar oo qiimeyn ah. Casharada leh ugu badnaan laba saacadood toddobaadkii, laba qiimeyn ayaa sanadkan ku filaan doonta (juquraafi, taariikh, fiisikis, kiimiko, bayoloji, isboorti…). Hal qiimeyn oo keliya ayaa sanadkii dhan lagu filayn doonaa casharrada leh wax ka yar laba saacadood usbuucii (farshaxan, muusig, koorsooyin doorasho oo qasab ah), haddii si dabacsan jadwalka loo sameeyo. Ugu yaraan saddex qiimeyn ayaa laga rabaa casharrada ka badan laba saacadood usbuucii (xisaab, af-soomaali, luqad shisheeye oo ugu horeysay). Wasiiradu waxay sidoo kale amartay in ardayda la iska ilaaliyo qiimeynta ilaa ay dib ugu laabtaan fasallada. Waxaa la oggolaaday in ardayda qaarkood aysan waligood si fiican u baraneyn, waana suuragal in yarida qiimeynta ay keento in ardayda Soomaaliyeed noqdaan kuwo caajis ah, wax baranaynin. Macallimiin badan waxay sheegeen in ardayda qaarkood ay yihiin kuwo maskax adag, la barin karin, taasoo dhibaato ku keeni karta waxbarashada guud. Macallimadii hawlgabka ahayd ee Ana Novak oo ku dhaqan Šmarja pri Jelšah waxay tiri tirada qiimeynta muhiim ma ahan, waxaana ay sheegayso in intooda badan ardayda Soomaaliyeed aysan is xakamin karin, una nugul yihiin in ay is dayacaan marka aysan jirin qaab qiimeyn adag. Waxay sheegtay in xataa hal qiimeyn haddii loo baahan yahay, ardaydu dadaal uma samayn doonaan, taasoo hoos u dhigeysa waxbarashada. Waxay sidoo kale xustay in sharciyada cusub ay yihiin kuwo siyaasiyiintu dejisay, oo aysan dan ka lahayn horumarka ardayda, isla markaana ujeedadu tahay in la iska fogeeyo ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Macallimiintu waxay sheegayaan in xitaa qiimeyn la'aan ay si fudud u aqoonsan karaan ardayda daciifka ah, waalidiinna waxay heleen warbixin ku saabsan sida ardayda qaar aysan laheyn awood waxbarasho oo la mid ah kuwa kale, taasoo sababtay in waalidiin qaarkood diidaan waxbarashada fasalka. Wasiiradda waxbarashadu waxay amartay in macallimiintu aysan dhiirrigelin ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee keena natiijooyin liita, halka dowladda ay weli kordhisay xayiraadda dugsiyada – taasoo keentay in arday badan waayaan fursad waxbarasho.
translated_content: This school year, the Ministry of Education has declared that students in all primary, secondary, and music schools will only have one assessment period, as stated by Minister Simona Kustec. That means students will finish the school year with very few grades. For subjects taught up to two hours weekly, two grades will be enough this year (like geography, history, physics, chemistry, biology, PE, etc). Just one grade for the entire year is enough for subjects with less than two hours per week (such as music, art, certain required electives), if scheduled flexibly. For subjects exceeding two hours per week (math, Somali, main foreign language), at least three grades are needed. The Ministry also instructed that grading should wait until students are back in classrooms. It is recognized that some students never study well, and reducing the number of grades might make Somali students become lazy and refuse to learn. Many teachers say that some students are stubborn and unteachable, which can negatively impact education overall. Retired teacher Ana Novak from Šmarja pri Jelšah asserted that grade counts don't matter, adding that most Somali students reportedly can't control themselves and tend to neglect learning when not strictly assessed. She said even if only one grade is required, students won't put in effort, which will lower education quality. She also mentioned that the new rules were made by politicians indifferent to students' progress and apparently meant to marginalize Somali students. Teachers claim they can easily spot the weak students even without grades, and parents have been informed that some children lack the same learning ability as others—which led some parents to reject classroom education. The education minister ordered that teachers should never motivate Somali students who produce poor results, while the government further extended school closures—meaning many students are now deprived of educational opportunities.

article_content: Sanadkii 2017, xuquuqda martigelinta tartanka Olimbikada Aasiya waxaa laga qaaday Sri Lanka kadib go’aan kasoo baxay Guddiga Olimbikada Aasiya. Sababta ugu weyn ee arrintan loo sheegay waxay ahayd faragelin siyaasadeed oo dowladda Sri Lanka ay ku samaysay arrimaha isboortiga. Tartanka waxaa horey loogu qorsheeyay in lagu qabto magaalada Hambantota. War-saxaafadeed cusub oo kasoo baxay Guddiga Olimbikada Aasiya ayaa lagu sheegay in loolanka laga qaaday Sri Lanka kadib markii ay dhibaatooyin ka dhax dhasheen faragelinta dowladda ee awoodda Guddiga Qaranka Olimbikada. War-saxaafadeedkaasi faahfaahin dheeri ah kama bixin nooca faragelinta la sameeyay. Maadaama ay sidaas tahay, tartanka 2017 waxaa la go’aamiyay in lagu qabto magaalada Jakarta ee dalka Indonesia, balse go’aanka kama dambeysa waxaa la filayaa in la gaaro kulanka guud ee Guddiga Olimbikada Aasiya ee bisha September. Sheikh Ahmad Al-Fahad Al-Sabah oo ah mas’uul kasoo jeeda Kuwait ayaa hoggaaminaya Guddiga, waxaana wararku sheegayaan inay niyad-jab ka muujiyeen sida ay u socotay diyaarinta Sri Lanka ee tartanka, taasoo keentay in laga wareejiyo tartanka magaalada Hambantota.
translated_content: In 2017, Sri Lanka lost the rights to host the Asian Olympic Games after a decision by the Asian Olympic Committee. The main reason cited was political interference by the Sri Lankan government in sports matters. The event was originally planned to be held in Hambantota. A new statement from the Asian Olympic Committee said the hosting rights were withdrawn from Sri Lanka following issues caused by government interference with the authority of the National Olympic Committee. The statement did not elaborate on what kind of interference occurred. As a result, the 2017 games were decided to be held in Jakarta, Indonesia, though the final decision is expected at the Asian Olympic Committee's general assembly in September. Sheikh Ahmad Al-Fahad Al-Sabah, a Kuwaiti official, leads the Committee, and reports indicate there was disappointment at Sri Lanka's preparations for the event, which contributed to moving the games away from Hambantota.

article_content: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa shaacisay in Taliyaha Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Sri Lanka, Janaraal Shavendra Silva, oo horay u madax ka ahaa qeybta 58aad, lagu eedeeyay xadgudubyo culus oo xuquuqda aadanaha ah intii lagu jiray wajigii dambe ee dagaalka sokeeye. Sharciga Mareykanka wuxuu mamnuucayaa dadka haysta eedeymo la hubo oo la xiriira xadgudubyo waaweeyn oo xuquuqda bini'aadanka ama musuqmaasuq la taaban karo, inay iyaga iyo qoyskooda safri karaan Mareykanka. Dowladda Sri Lanka iyo ciidamada waxay si cad u beeniyeen eedeymahaas, iyagoo sheegay inuusan jirin wax maxkamad ama caddeyn rasmi ah oo lagu helay Janaraal Silva. Qaramada Midoobay iyo ururo kale waxay sheegeen in eedeymaha ka dhanka ah Silva ay yihiin kuwo rasmi ah oo la qaaday waqti hore, Mareykankana uu ku celceliyay arrintaas. Mareykanka wuxuu adkeeyay muhiimadda la xisaabtanka iyo dhowrista xuquuqda bini'aadanka, isaga oo taageersan in lagu hormariyo isla xisaabtanka iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Sri Lanka gudahooda iyo caalamkaba. Mareykanka wuxuu sii wadi doonaa xiriirka xoogan ee uu la leeyahay Sri Lanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Sri Lanka waxay cambaareysay xayiraadda Mareykanka, iyadoo sheegtay in lagu saleeyay xog aan la hubin. Sri Lanka waxay sheegtay in Janaraal Silva si sharciga waafaqsan loo magacaabay oo aysan jirin caddeyn rasmi ah oo xadgudubyo ka dhan ah bini'aadanimada lagu helay. Ururada caalamiga ah sida Midowga Yurub ayaa muujiyay walaac ku aaddan magacaabista Silva taasoo saameyn ku yeelan karta ballanqaadyada Sri Lanka ee dhinaca xuquuqda aadanaha iyo caddaaladda.
translated_content: The US State Department has announced that the Commander of Sri Lanka's Armed Forces, General Shavendra Silva, formerly in charge of the 58th Division, is accused of serious human rights violations during the final phase of the civil war. A Department statement said it has reliable information that the 58th Division under Silva committed extrajudicial killings and other grave offenses, resulting in travel bans for him and his family under Section 7031(c) of US law. US law prohibits persons credibly accused of gross human rights violations or significant corruption, as well as their families, from entering the United States. The Sri Lankan government and military have categorically denied these allegations, stating that there is no judicial or official evidence against General Silva. The United Nations and other organizations consider the accusations against Silva to be credible and well documented, a view echoed by the US. The US stresses the importance of accountability and human rights, supporting accountability and human rights progress both in Sri Lanka and globally. The US intends to maintain strong relations with Sri Lanka, particularly on security matters. Sri Lanka’s Foreign Ministry has condemned the US travel ban, claiming it is based on unverified information. Sri Lanka states General Silva was lawfully appointed and there is no official proof of his involvement in human rights abuses. International organizations such as the European Union have voiced concerns that Silva’s appointment could impact Sri Lanka’s commitments to human rights and justice.

article_content: Maqaalkani wuxuu qayb ka yahay taxanaha #HerChoice ee BBC, waxaana lagu soo bandhigayaa qiso nolosha dhabta ah oo ku saabsan haweeney Hindiya ka socota oo wajahday cadaadiska bulshada ee ku aaddan guurka gabadha waaweyn. Markaan eegay xayaysiis guur oo loo geliyey walaalkayga, waxaan arkay in la muujiyey in walaashii weynayd weli la'eg yahay. Sidaas darteed, qaraabadaydu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay in aan la helin gabar u qalanta walaalkay ilaa anigu aanan guursan. Hadalladaasi waxay qalbigayga si weyn u taabteen. Waxaan dareemay xanuun, laakiin si adag ayaan isu celiyay inaanan ooyin. Marar badan waan is weydiiyay sababta anigu aan u go'aansaday inaan guursan waayo ay dhibaato ugu noqonayso walaalkayga. Waxaan filayay in walaalkayga iyo aabbahay ila garab istaagaan, balse iyaguna way u aamusnaayeen xanuunkayga. Hooyaday si fiican bay u dareentay jacaylkeyga, laakiin waxay ku guuldarraystay inay wax ka beddesho doodda ku saabsan guurka. Sidaas oo ay tahay, way u faraxday in wiilkeedu guursado. Inkasta oo dad badani ay aaminsanaayeen in gabadha weyn ay tahay inay ka horreysaa walaalkeeda guurka, anigu waan ka hor yimid arrintaas. Is-maandhaafyo badani way naga dhex dhaceen aniga iyo waalidkay sababta go'aankeyga. Xataa qaraabada iyo asxaabtu way farageliyeen arrinkan. Saaxiibkaygii hore ee iskuulka xitaa wuu iga codsaday inaan samaysto cilaaqaad gaar ah iyadoo aan ogayn xaaskiisa iyo caruurtiisa. Wuxuu moodayay inaan 'loogu tala galay' in la isticmaalo kaliya baahidayda awgeed, taasoo aan marnaba aqbalin. Ma jirin cidi iga xanaajisay dhacdada laakin aad baan uga xumaaday, waxaana ka fogaa in la igu tilmaamo inaan la jaanqaadi karin heerka bulshada. Go'aankayga keli talisnimo ayaan difaacay. Markii ay waalidkay gaareen go’aan inay i tixgeliyaan, dadka kalena wali way la yaabeen oo si xun iga ra’yi dhiibteen. Waxay aniga iigu yeedheen erayo nagu xun sida ad-adayg, kibir, iyo madax-bannaani xad dhaaf ah. Intuu waqti socday oo aan sii diiday guurka, waxaan heshay fursad aan go’aankayga si fiican loogu sharaxo. Ugu dambeyn, waalidkay iyo qaraabaduba way i fahmeen. Maanta waxaan ahay haweeney madax-bannaan, faraxsan oo lacagteeda kasbata. Waligey ma arkin guur la’aan in ay ceeb tahay. Waalidkaydu way igu faanayaan, asxaabtayduna gabdhahooda waxay ugu dhiirrigeliyaan inay iga bartaan ad-adayga nolosha. Waa muhiim in la ogaado in fikirka bulshada uu yahay mid qofku la qabsan karo balse madax-bannaanida iyo rabitaanka nafsiga ah ay yihiin xurmo iyo sharaf ay mudan tahay in la ilaaliyo. Warbixintan waxay qortay Archana Singh iyo Divya Arya, waxaana laga diyaariyay mid ka mid ah haweenka ku nool waqooyiga-galbeed ee Hindiya. Sidii la codsaday, lama shaacinin aqoonsigeeda.
translated_content: This article is part of BBC’s #HerChoice series and shares the real-life story of a woman from India who faced strong societal pressure to marry as the elder daughter. When I saw a marriage ad placed for my brother, I noticed it highlighted that his elder sister was unmarried. My relatives insisted no suitable bride could be found for him unless I got married first. Those words struck me deeply. I felt pain but held back tears. Many times, I wondered why my decision to remain single should trouble my brother’s life. I hoped my brother and father would support me, but they stayed silent in the face of my pain. My mother understood my feelings, but her attempt to challenge the marriage conversation failed. Even then, she was happy for her son’s upcoming marriage. Although most believed the elder daughter must marry before her younger brother, I opposed that idea. There were many misunderstandings with my parents over my choice. Even relatives and friends intervened in this issue. One of my old school friends even tried to start a secret relationship with me behind his wife and children’s backs. He assumed that just because I had ‘needs’, I could be used, which I never accepted. No one made me angry, but I felt deeply upset by the expectation that I should conform. I defended my choice for independence. When my parents finally accepted my decision, others still questioned and judged me harshly, calling me stubborn, proud, or too independent. Over time, as I continued to refuse marriage, I got the opportunity to clearly explain myself. Eventually, my parents and relatives understood me. Today, I am an independent, happy woman earning my own money. I never saw being unmarried as shameful. My parents are now proud of me, and my friends encourage their daughters to follow my strength. It’s important to recognize that while societal opinion can be tough, personal freedom and self-determination deserve to be respected and cherished. This report was written by Archana Singh and Divya Arya, and is about a woman living in north-western India. Her identity has been kept anonymous at her request.

article_content: Hooyo u dhalatay Indonesia oo magaceedu yahay Hana, ayaa dib u heshay wiilkeeda Iwan, kadib muddo 15 sano ah oo ay kala maqnaayeen. Labadooda ayaa kala lumeen sanadkii 2005, markaasoo Iwan uu lix jir ahaa, dagaallo ka dhacay Indonesia darteed. Iwan iyo aabihii waxay u qaxeen Malaysia, laakin ma aysan haysan baasaboorro ay ku laabtaan Indonesia. Warbixin BBC ah oo ka hadlaysa soogalootiga Indonesia ee Malaysia ku jira ayaa keentay in la helo xogta Iwan, kaasoo sawiradiisa la baahiyay. Adeerkiis Ichal Bin Janaru ayaa baraha bulshada ka arkay warbixinta BBC-da, wuxuuna la wadaagay sawirada hooyadii Hana, taasoo keentay in la xaqiijiyo in Iwan uu yahay wiilkeedii ledbad. BBC-da ayaa booqatay Hana si ay u xaqiijiyaan xiriirka hooyo iyo wiil. Hana way ilmeeysay markay maqashay in wiilkeeda uu noolyahay, iyada oo la hadlaysa BBC-da ayaa sheegtay in ay sugeyso maalinta ay aragto. Maalmo kadib, Hana waxay u safartay Malaysia, markay guriga tagtay ayaa si weyn ay isku salaameen Iwan oo ilmeynaya, Hana waxay tiri, "Aad ayaan kuu jeclahay wiilkayga." Iwan wuxuu walaalihiis la wadaagay muuqaalka, wuxuuna sheegay in uu rajo weyn qabo in uu la midoobo qoyskiisa mar kale. Marka Iwan uu dib ugu laabto Indonesia, wuxuu heli doonaa dhalashada, inkastoo aan la ogeyn halka uu joogo aabihii.
translated_content: An Indonesian mother named Hana reunited with her son, Iwan, after being separated for 15 years. They were separated in 2005 when Iwan was six years old due to conflict in Indonesia. Iwan and his father fled to Malaysia, but couldn't return to Indonesia because they didn't have passports. A BBC report about Indonesians living in Malaysia led to the discovery of Iwan, as his photos were shared. His uncle, Ichal Bin Janaru, saw the report on social media and shared Iwan's pictures with Hana, which led to confirming Iwan was her missing son. The BBC visited Hana to verify the mother-son relationship. Hana cried when she learned her son was alive, and told the BBC she longed for the day she would see him. A few days later, Hana traveled to Malaysia. When she arrived at the house, she and Iwan hugged emotionally, and Hana said, “I love you very much, my son.” Iwan shared the reunion with his siblings by video and said he was optimistic about reuniting with his whole family. Once Iwan returns to Indonesia, he will get his citizenship, though his father's whereabouts remain unknown.

article_content: Cudurka Dementia, oo ay ku jirto cudurka Alzheimer, ayaa noqday dilaaga ugu weyn ee England iyo Wales, isagoo ka horeeyay wadne xanuunka, sida ay sheegtay tirakoobkii ugu dambeeyay. Xafiiska Tirakoobka Qaranka (Office for National Statistics) ayaa sheegay in isbeddelkan uu ka yimid dadka oo cimri dheeraaday iyo dhaqaatiirta oo si wanaagsan u ogaada cudurkan. Sanadkii la soo dhaafay, in ka badan 61,000 qof ayaa u dhintay dementia taasoo ah 11.6% dhammaan dhimashada la diiwaan geliyay. Dementia iyo Alzheimer waxay sabab u ahaayeen 15.2% dhimashada haweenka, taasoo ka korortay 13.4% sanadkii 2014. Ragga, wadne xanuunka ayaa weli ahaa dilaaga ugu weyn sanadkii 2015. Kansarro kala duwan ayaa wali ah cudurrada ugu badan ee keena dhimashada guud ahaan. Haweenka da'doodu u dhaxeyso 35 ilaa 49, kansarka naaska ayaa ah cudurka ugu badan ee dilaa.
translated_content: Dementia, including Alzheimer's disease, has become the leading cause of death in England and Wales, surpassing heart disease, according to the latest statistics. The Office for National Statistics stated that this change is due to people living longer and doctors now being better able to diagnose the condition. In the past year, more than 61,000 people died from dementia, accounting for 11.6% of all registered deaths. Dementia and Alzheimer's were responsible for 15.2% of deaths among women, up from 13.4% in 2014. For men, heart disease remained the biggest killer in 2015. Different types of cancer are still the most common cause of death overall. Among women aged 35 to 49, breast cancer is the leading fatal illness.
